_comment: HOP 2 - what the line_crossing kernel MUST emit. This is the hand-off type SStageEvent, and it is the INPUT to the next stage. Exactly one event: track 7 crossed between frame 2 and 3. The untracked detection in frame 4 produced nothing.
_the_point: Every field here is required downstream. timestamp_us for the correlation window, camera_id to know the source, track_id for identity, bbox so stage 2 can crop without re-detecting. A kernel that omits one has produced something that compiles and cannot be composed.
